component.name: Aloft
component.summary: Aerial video screensaver for Wayland desktops

description.p: Aloft plays the aerial videos known from Apple TV as a screensaver when your computer is idle. It downloads them from Apple's servers when you ask it to and does not include them. Aloft is not affiliated with Apple.
Videos are decoded in hardware. On computers with two GPUs the integrated one does the decoding, so the dedicated one stays free.
